    Splice SNB REER with CREA Proxy and Component Projections

    splice_reer_series.Rd

    Constructs a real-time REER level trajectory up to \(T+8\) quarters ahead by splicing official historical SNB data with the chained CREA proxy across publication lag periods and appending component-based forecasts.

    splice_reer_series(
  vantage_quarter = "2023 Q2",
  snb_reer_delay = 3,
  data = master_philips,
  burn_in = "1982 Q1"
)

    Arguments

    vantage_quarter

    Character, Date, or yearqtr. The pseudo-real-time forecast origin. Defaults to "2023 Q2".

    snb_reer_delay

    Integer. Publication lag of the official SNB REER in quarters. Defaults to 3.

    data

    A data frame containing quarterly series for quarter, reer_eu_ppi, REER_CREA, ppi_ch_idx, ppi_eur_idx, and ex_eoq.

    burn_in

    Character or yearqtr. Historical sample start date. Defaults to "1982 Q1".

    Value

    A tibble with two columns:

    quarter

    Quarterly dates of class yearqtr spanning burn_in to vantage_quarter + 2 years.

    reer_simulated

    Spliced historical and forecasted REER levels.

    Details

    Official SNB REER data is subject to publication lags. The function determines the last published observation at cutoff_q = vantage_quarter - snb_reer_delay/4 and bridges the gap to the forecast origin (vantage_quarter) using chained growth rates of the observed CREA proxy.

    From the vantage point forward, 8-quarter-ahead projections are generated via forecast_reer_components (Random Walk exchange rates and auto-ARIMA price indices) and chained to the spliced level.

    See also

    forecast_reer_components, splice_snb_series
